sourceText.he: חוֹמֶר בִּזְרוֹעַ [וְכוּ׳]. וְלִיתְנֵי חוֹמֶר בְּרֵאשִׁית הַגֵּז, שֶׁנּוֹהֵג בִּטְרֵפוֹת, מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּמַתָּנוֹת!

positions.claim: the stringencies run only from the priestly gifts toward the first sheared wool
the first sheared wool has its own stringency, since it applies to a tereifa while the gifts are not given from one
positions.basis: "ונתן לכהן" — the gifts must be given to the priest himself, and a tereifa is forbidden to him
